name: Hidden Assets
description: A routine raid led by Emer Berry, a detective in the Irish Criminal Assets Bureau, reveals that a small-time drug dealer has been receiving substantial funding from a seemingly untraceable source – not in cash, but in rough diamonds. When these diamonds are linked to a series of bombings in Belgium, Emer is forced to work with Police Commissioner Christian De Jong.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Det Sergeant Emer Berry of the CAB leads a raid on a criminals house in Co Clare, while there, She discovers deeds and diamonds linking the Homeowner to a terrorist attack in Antwep.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Darren's killers escape, while Christian tells Emer further bombings are expected. Billionaire Richard Melnick shows the Antwerp site for his new European headquarters to his son

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Diamonds are found in Fionn Brannigan's offices and Emer links this to the bombings and warns him his life is in danger. Christian learns Hadi has been beaten by a fellow officer

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Emer heads to Antwerp to help search for Fionn Brannigan, but just as the case seems to have hit a dead end, the discovery of a body and a forensics breakthrough changes everything

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: While her team follows the money trail in Ireland, Emer and Christian discover the identity of the bombers. An unexpected source provides the investigation with vital information

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: With Bibi now in custody, Emer and Christian face a desperate race against time to stop the final bombing and uncover who was really behind the terror campaign

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Claire is new to the fold as the lead Detective Sergeant in charge at the Criminal Assets Bureau (CAB) and faces a sudden challenge.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: DS Claire Wallace and CI Christian De Jong are shocked to discover who was behind the terrorist attacks, but as the body count grows, will they be able to prove it?

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Bibi Brannigan's life hangs in the balance when a hitman arrives in Ireland. A PR disaster threatens Frances Swann's plans, forcing her to take drastic action.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: In the aftermath of a chilling attack in Ireland, Claire heads to Antwerp to make contact with a key witness. When Christian hits a dead end in his investigation, help comes from an unexpected source.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: As Claire and Christian close in on hard evidence connecting Trestford to the bombings, Frances Swann executes a callous plan to force Bibi to Antwerp.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: In this gripping series finale, Claire and her CAB team are in a race against time to finally unmask those behind the terrorist bombings before the Antwerp port deal is signed. But their breakthrough comes at a very heavy price.
